```{r}
library(webexercises)
```

```{webr-r}
# 1. Define a vector of scores
scores <- c(88, 92, 79, 95, 84)

# 2. Compute summary statistics
mean_score <- mean(scores)
sd_score   <- sd(scores)

cat("Mean:", mean_score, "\nSD:", sd_score)
```

## Check your understanding

Run the code above, then answer these questions.

1. What is the mean of `scores`? `r fitb(87.6, num = TRUE, tol = 0.05)`

2. Which function computes the standard deviation in R? `r mcq(c("var()", answer = "sd()", "mean()", "range()"))`

3. True or false: `c()` combines values into a vector. `r torf(TRUE)`

`r hide("Show hint")`
Add the five scores and divide by 5: (88 + 92 + 79 + 95 + 84) / 5.
`r unhide()`
